title: Certificates of Deposit: Tier Line-Up, Term Lengths and Rate Structures
content:
Piedmont Crescent Bank sells its Certificates of Deposit in six tiers. Each tier is defined, first of all, by how long one term runs and by the kind of rate the certificate carries during that term. This page is the quick reference for those two attributes.

## Standing terms

1. A term is measured in whole calendar months, and every tier has one fixed term length.
2. Each tier carries one of three rate structures: a fixed rate; a fixed rate on a no-penalty certificate; or a bump-up rate, meaning a rate the owner may ask to have raised during the term under that tier's bump-up terms.
3. The structure label names the kind of certificate only. The penalty, bump-up, add-on and grace terms that give each structure its practical effect are tier parameters in their own right and are not inferred from the label.

## Tier table

| Tier (official name, by rank) | Months in one term | Rate structure |
|---|---|---|
| 6-Month Certificate | 6 | Fixed |
| 11-Month No-Penalty Certificate | 11 | Fixed, no-penalty certificate |
| 12-Month Certificate | 12 | Fixed |
| 18-Month Bump-Up Certificate | 18 | Bump-up |
| 36-Month Certificate | 36 | Fixed |
| 60-Month Certificate | 60 | Fixed |

## Reading the table

- The number of months applies to every term of the tier, the first term and each renewed term alike, because a renewed term is a term of whatever tier the certificate renews into.
- Only one tier, the 18-Month Bump-Up Certificate, carries the bump-up structure; the other five are fixed for the whole term, one of them being the no-penalty certificate.

## Points of judgement

**Does the term length change if a certificate renews into another tier?** The new term takes the length of the tier it renews into, since the table attaches the length to the tier, not to the certificate.

**Illustration (hypothetical).** A certificate renewing into the 36-Month Certificate tier runs 36 calendar months for that new term, whatever tier it held before.
